skills.name: Meta Ads MCP Connector
skills.description: MCP-backed connector for read-only Meta Ads performance and campaign metadata retrieval.

capabilities: Pull campaign, ad set, and ad metrics for fixed reporting windows.
Return spend, delivery, click, and conversion fields in normalized rows.
Preserve source timestamps for QA and freshness validation.
auth_required: Meta Ads account scope via authenticated MCP runtime
operational.approval_boundary: Safe for reporting queries only; require human approval before pairing with any workflow that can modify campaigns, budgets, or creative state.

skills.name: Ad Platform Executor Template
skills.description: MCP/tool template for a narrow DV360 and Google Ads executor that applies only approved, policy-checked campaign changes and records rollback evidence.

operational.connected_system: DV360 and Google Ads API execution layer
capabilities: Read current campaign or line item state before execution.
Validate approved change plans against policy and current platform state.
Apply bounded bid, budget, targeting, or status changes.
Verify post-write state and create rollback patches.
auth_required: Approval token for medium and high-risk writes
operational.approval_boundary: Applies only policy-approved bounded writes; high-risk changes require human approval and rollback evidence.

skills.name: Conversion Event Reconciler
skills.description: Deterministically deduplicate browser and server conversion events and reconcile them with first-party business outcomes.

operational.connected_system: Local event fixtures or approved event export
capabilities: Deduplicate browser and server events by event name and event ID.
Preserve event provenance and flag conflicting values.
Reconcile conversions with first-party outcomes.
operational.approval_boundary: Reads supplied files and writes JSON to stdout; live event collection and platform uploads are out of scope.

skills.name: OpenAI Ads Adapter Template
skills.description: Mock-first read-only adapter contract for OpenAI Ads accounts, campaigns, ads, insights, and product feeds.

operational.connected_system: OpenAI Ads API or local mock fixtures
capabilities: Read advertiser account metadata.
List campaigns and ads.
Retrieve campaign insights.
Validate product-feed records.
auth_required: Account-scoped OpenAI Ads API credential for live bindings
operational.approval_boundary: Read-only by design; future writes must use the existing policy-gated ad-platform executor.

skills.name: Agent Control Plane MCP Server
skills.description: MCP server template for policy checks, approval requests, agent action logging, and audit-chain verification.

capabilities: Check proposed agent actions against JSON policy rules.
Record agent action events with input and output hashes.
Create approval requests for high-risk actions.
Verify audit hash-chain continuity.
operational.approval_boundary: Safe for policy checks and audit writes; requires human approval before executing high-risk operational actions or changing policy.

skills.name: GA4 MCP Connector
skills.description: MCP-backed GA4 query connector for structured marketing analytics retrieval.

capabilities: Pull sessions, users, conversions, and revenue by allowed dimensions.
Query fixed date windows for period comparisons and dashboard inputs.
Return normalized analytics payloads for downstream skills and agents.
auth_required: GA4 property access via authenticated MCP runtime
operational.approval_boundary: Safe for read-only analytics retrieval; require human approval before combining with any workflow that writes back to ad platforms or reporting systems.

skills.name: BigQuery MCP Query Runner
skills.description: Execute parameterized read-only BigQuery SQL through MCP for analytics and BI workflows.

capabilities: Execute parameterized read-only SQL templates for analytics workflows.
Return typed warehouse rows for BI transformations and reporting.
Enforce query guardrails such as timeout, limits, and statement restrictions.
auth_required: BigQuery dataset access via authenticated MCP runtime
operational.approval_boundary: Safe for parameterized read-only queries; require human approval before broadening dataset scope or enabling any non-read-only SQL path.
